data.title: 蕾塞 · 暴雨电话亭·狭小空间与湿发回眸
data.description: 【蕾塞 · 暴雨电话亭·狭小空间与湿发回眸】狂风暴雨席卷的东京街头，狭小而闷热的红色公用电话亭成了唯一的避难所。湿透的短发紧贴着蕾塞白皙的脸颊，雨水顺着她的脖颈流淌进衣领。她转过身在极近的距离凝视着你——「这里好挤……但是很暖和呢。电次君，心跳声吵得我都要听不清外面的雨声了。」
data.promptProse: Inside the cramped glass telephone booth, Reze looks back through wet bangs, her sleeveless white collared shirt, loose black tie and choker pin retaining the selected outfit. The close-up includes the receiver and narrow pane edges beside her face, black shorts below the crop. Diffuse storm light softly reveals her eyes, while blurred street neon filters through rain-streaked glass and reflects in droplets, leaving the booth corners darker behind her.
data.action: 湿发回眸，雨幕模糊街景
